晚安: maan5 on1 - good night, night peaceful
早上: zou2 soeng6 - morning (soeng6 = trailing tone for 2 syllables)
午安: ng5 on1 - good afternoon, noon peaceful — "have a good afternoon nap"
我玩紧网球: ngo5 waan2 gan2 mong5 kau4 - I (am) playing tennis
我早上: ngo5 zou2 soeng6 - (I … in the morning)
我早上跑步，打网球: ngo5 zou2 soeng6 paau2 bou6, daa2 mong5 kau4 - In the morning I run, play tennis
你食咗饭未: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 - (have you eaten yet?) / nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 - (object comes between)
咗: zo2 - "-ed", past tense, left side / zo2 - already / zo2 - past perfect
你食咗未: nei5 sik6 zo2 mei6 - have you eaten yet or not?
你跑步咗未: nei5 paau2 bou6 zo2 mei6 - have you run yet or not?
你有咗未: nei5 jau5 zo2 mei6 - have you had it?
你玩咗未: nei5 waan2 zo2 mei6 - have you played it?
你玩咗佢未: nei5 waan2 zo2 keoi5 mei6 - have you played it or not?
佢玩咗未: keoi5 waan2 zo2 mei6 - has that person played it?
我食咗饭: ngo5 sik6 zo2 faan6 - (I have eaten)
乒乓球: ping1 pong2 kau4 - ping pong ball
以前: ji5 cin4 - before / ji5 cin4 - past tense
以前以前: ji5 cin4 ji5 cin4 - (say it twice)
我系以前: ngo5 hai6 ji5 cin4 - I was
我食以前?: ngo5 sik6 ji5 cin4 - I don't eat anymore
我未食: ngo5 mei6 sik6 - I haven't eaten
